name: Navbar
description: Mortar navbar: horizontal application navigation with brand, current-page indicator and actions, collapsing into a disclosure menu on narrow screens.

props.items: NavbarItem[] (LinkItem { label: string; href: string; current?: boolean; count?: number | string; icon?: ReactNode }, or a group { label: string; items: FlyoutItem[] } opens a dropdown panel of links ({ label; href; description?; icon?; current? }); a group holding the current page is marked current, and on narrow screens it opens inside the menu)
props.label: string
props.tone: "default" | "inverse" | "accent" (default "default"; the bar's surface. inverse: the other appearance, through the inverse token remap. accent: the brand's accent fill, its gradient when it defines one, with on-accent links, focus and actions. Dropdown panels keep the page's colours)

contract.usage: Import { Navbar } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
